text:
maria_s: Hey team — we need a quick sync on vendor roadmap alignment across marketplace + SI integrations. H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi timelines are starting to overlap with our planned marketplace waves and SI onboarding windows. Can folks confirm hard dates and any embargo constraints?

ajay_k: Short answer: MI300 driver GA is shaky for the week we're targeting. I have a vendor call tomorrow, will confirm, but might be a +1 week risk. :grimacing:

lin_d: Reminder: Dedicated capacity freeze for Q3 wave opens on 2065437500 — if we miss that, capacity guarantees slip. We need final model images by EOW to hit it.

maria_s: Noted. I put together a tentative matrix: 
```
Vendor   | Model  | Marketplace list | SI cert window | Embargo lift
Nvidia   | H200   | 2065440000        | 2065439000      | 2065443600
Nvidia   | B200   | 2065443600        | 2065440000      | 2065447200
AMD      | MI300  | 2065447200        | 2065443600      | 2065450800
GaudiCo  | Gaudi  | 2065443600        | 2065440000      | 2065447200
```
This is rough — highlights the contention around 2065443600-2065447200.

tom_p: That overlap is rough for marketing/press. If MI300 slips, we can move its marketplace listing 1 week later — that frees the earlier slot for B200/Gaudi. 

kate_partnerships: Marketing needs firm embargo lift times to assemble joint press decks. Also need final logos + partner quotes 5 business days before embargo. Who owns chasing vendor comms? @ajay_k?

ajay_k: I can own vendor comms for Nvidia/AMD. Will push for explicit embargo timestamps. For Gaudi I think @lin_d has working relationship with the partner PM.

lin_d: Yep I’ll handle Gaudi ops and SI cert scheduling. Quick ask to engineering: can we produce the SI test image with perf harness by 2065439400?

naveen_eng: We can, but need the model artifacts and quantization profiles from model-onboard. If vendors deliver artifacts late we’ll have to run a minimal perf sweep only. Also callout: for MI300 we need a new ROCm driver from partner to run our autotuner. That’s the main blocker.

vendor_ops_bot: Reminder: Partner embargo policy requires signed joint announcement NDA before embargo lift. See https://intra.redwood/partnerships/embargo-policy.

maria_s: OK action items: (1) @ajay_k confirm MI300 driver GA and embargo time on vendor call tomorrow, (2) @lin_d own Gaudi SI cert slot, (3) @naveen_eng note dependency for perf harness, (4) @kate_partnerships hold provisional marketing timeline but await embargo confirm. I’ll send a 30m sync invite for 2065432800 so we can lock decisions.

tom_p: :thumbsup: moving marketplace wave by a week is acceptable if needed, but callers in sales should be alerted now.

ajay_k: Update after call tomorrow — will post final timestamps and NDA status.

lin_d: Adding checklist to the calendar invite: image tags, perf checklist, SI test plan, embargo contact list.

maria_s: Thanks — if nobody objects, we’ll treat the matrix above as our working plan until updated. If anything major pops, ping this thread.

kate_partnerships: One more: coordinate with channel-sales for buyer-facing comms, I’ll add them to the invite.

naveen_eng: OK, prepping the perf harness stub now. Will need ~24h to validate once artifacts arrive.

vendor_ops_bot: Noted — NDA checklist updated.

maria_s: Great. See you on the sync.
